findings.issue: importorskip also skips an installed gateway whose submodule or transitive dependency is missing, so a broken Hermes contract check exits successfully. Skip only when the top-level gateway package is absent.

All future rounds must contain the old product SHA and the latest report must stay NOT CLEAN 0/2 with the old issue IDs. This rejects legitimate post-fix audits required by issue #5; scope the frozen assertions to the historical rounds.
Reports with the same round number overwrite each other in the dictionary, allowing an invalid report to escape every content check. Reject duplicate round numbers before assignment.

summary: Fixed three test defects: installed Hermes import failures now fail, duplicate audit rounds are rejected, and historical SHA/status assertions no longer block future qualifying audits. Five regression cases failed before the fixes; the Git Bash test command now reports 9 passed and 1 expected skip, while the full suite remains unverified on this Windows host because its pre-fix collection lacks native Hermes plugins and fcntl.
